say:5:1220307003:1.text: Let's all calm down a bit... It's not like I don't have money to give you, but I reckon I have something else you want more.

say:8:1220307006:1.text: I heard you're investigating a rat infestation.
say:8:1220307006:1.source_cn: 我听说，你们在调查鼠患。
say:8:1220307006:1.male: I heard you're investigating a rat infestation.
say:8:1220307006:1.female: I heard you're investigating a rat infestation.

say:9:1220307007:1.text: As to how I know, don't ask. I won't tell you.
say:9:1220307007:1.source_cn: 至于我是怎么知道的，你就别问了，问了也不告诉你。
say:9:1220307007:1.male: As to how I know, don't ask. I won't tell you.
say:9:1220307007:1.female: As to how I know, don't ask. I won't tell you.

say:10:1220307008:1.text: I just want to let you know that the rat infestation isn't as simple as you think. That's because...
say:10:1220307008:1.source_cn: 我只想提醒你，这次的鼠患没那么简单，因为……

say:14:1220307011:0.text: Yeah, I thought it was bullspit at first, too. After all, we're in Rustport, where people make their living as liars and cheats.
say:14:1220307011:0.source_cn: 是的，一开始我也以为是胡说八道。毕竟我们这地方，喜欢瞎...

say:15:1220307012:0.text: But it wasn't until today that I realized the rumors weren't codswallop. How could the fish I prepared for the Whispers just disappear like that?
say:15:1220307012:0.source_cn: 但是……直到今天，我给血薇帮的鱼一转眼就没了，我才知道...

say:16:1220307013:0.text: Didn't you say the fish was eaten by rats?
say:16:1220307013:0.source_cn: 你不是说，鱼被老鼠吃了吗？

say:17:1220307014:1.text: I did, but you know, there was a 50-pound fish in that basket.
say:17:1220307014:1.source_cn: 我是说了，但你要知道，那可是一条五十磅的鱼。

say:18:1220307015:1.text: How can a rat carry away a 50-pound fish? It must've been huge!
say:18:1220307015:1.source_cn: 普通的老鼠哪能叼走五十磅重的鱼？那肯定是一只体型巨大的老鼠！

say:20:1220307016:0.text: 50 pounds... That's heavier than Chippy's armor.
say:20:1220307016:0.source_cn: 五十磅……比穿着盔甲的满满还要重了。

say:21:1220307017:0.text: Mr. Fisherman, where is the man who saw the monster? We want to go talk to him.
say:21:1220307017:0.source_cn: 渔夫先生，那个亲眼见到怪物的人在哪里？我们想去找那人聊聊。

say:22:1220307018:0.text: He's a sailor named <style="highlight">Ricard</style>. He should be near the <style="highlight">docks</style> around this time of day.

choice:4:0:1.female: Cut the crap and pay up.
